scope: Current exteriors of Shinko’s two red brick warehouses and their plaza in Yokohama. No. 1 is the shortened post-earthquake building. No. 2 retains the long warehouse frontage.

references.caption: Old Akarenga stock house in Yokohama.

originalReview.notes: Binh Giang’s 2003 plaza view shows both warehouse ends, three levels of punched windows, repeated front gables, roof partitions on the long warehouse and covered galleries. Its Qualla bytes match the creator’s original worldwide public-domain release.
